title: CausalHypothesis
description: A node in a causal claims graph (HOPE-derived, hardened): a labeled, DIRECTION-NEUTRAL, falsifiable hypothesis with topic terms for evidence selection. Polarity NEVER lives in hypothesis text — it lives on CausalEdge.sign, closing the source notation's inconsistency ('will improve' baked into text vs dash-dot edges). Claim-shaped content takes the 5-axis claims verdict model, never the ops ternary. Template slots are typed fields, not literal '<<placeholders>>'. Invariants (enforced by allOf/if-then): claimStatus evidenced or scored requires at least one warrant; scored requires a claimVerdictRef. Deduplication: hypotheses extracted from multiple documents resolve through the entity-resolution spine via entityClusterRef, or the graph silently double-counts causes.

specVersion.description: Epistemic-kernel contract version, pinned. Changing this const is a contract change.

graphRef.description: URN of the causal graph (customer- or domain-parameterized model instance) this node belongs to.

hypothesis.description: Falsifiable, direction-neutral statement of the event/condition (e.g. 'Tariff rates on product parts change'). Polarity belongs on edges; a hypothesis whose text encodes direction is malformed even though text neutrality cannot be machine-checked here.

kind.description: literal: a concrete topic term used to select evidence articles; template: a typed slot name (e.g. customer_name) bound at graph instantiation.

value.description: The topic term or the slot name.

topics.description: Topic terms for evidence selection. Required (empty allowed — the source model permits topic-less events) so the selection posture is explicit.

kkoTypeRef.description: KBpedia Knowledge Ontology reference-concept typing this hypothesis. Optional at v0.1, but untyped nodes recreate the untyped-graph debt already paid down once.

entityClusterRef.description: Entity-resolution cluster URN when this hypothesis has been resolved against the ER spine.

claimStatus.description: Lifecycle of the claim: proposed (no warrants yet), evidenced (warrant-backed), scored (5-axis verdict issued).

claimVerdictRef.description: URN of the 5-axis claims verdict artifact. Required when claimStatus is scored (enforced by if/then).

items.description: URN of a warrant/evidence artifact (e.g. an EvidenceAtom).

warrantRefs.description: Warrants backing this hypothesis. Required (empty allowed only while proposed) so the evidence posture is always explicit.
